## D — Accuracy and evidence notes: Vehicle equipment, insurance, titles and registration
Every knowledge statement for Vehicle equipment, insurance, titles and registration is tied to one physical page of the registered Delaware handbook snapshot. No outside legal explanation or inferred exception is added.
The detailed tint subsection permits an approved side-window waiver, while the inspection checklist uses blanket wording. The detailed and checklist scopes must not be flattened into one absolute rule. Fee and equipment statements describe this handbook snapshot.
The alternative-fuel fee table is retained as individually cited rows. Commercial and trailer fee formulas, payment-brand availability and contact details are outside the selected passenger-car teaching emphasis.
Open source limitation (verify DE-EQUIPMENT-TINT): The detailed equipment subsection provides a side-window waiver while the inspection checklist states a blanket tint restriction; the windshield AS-1 wording also says masking. Preserve this source ambiguity rather than inventing a unified exception.
Open source limitation (verify DE-EQUIPMENT-INSPECTION): The diesel model-year wording and the newer-vehicle renewal-period wording are not sufficiently clear to infer the complete eligibility table. Withhold those inferred boundaries and seek issuer clarification.
Source quality: official issuer PDF. Extraction is text only; graphical content does not become a fact unless its supporting meaning is stated in the text. Unknown exam metadata and market evidence remain typed debt.
